# eslint-plugin-cli-floor

Guide for AI coding assistants using this plugin in a project. To change the plugin's own source, read https://github.com/ofri-peretz/eslint/blob/main/AGENTS.md instead.

> ESLint plugin for the CLI floor — every commander, yargs or burgee command declares a description and a one-line example, writes through the output layer instead of console, and backs every prompt with a flag.

## Enable it

```bash
npm install --save-dev eslint-plugin-cli-floor
```

Requires ESLint ^8.40.0 || ^9.0.0 || ^10.0.0 and Node >=18.0.0.

Flat config files (`eslint.config.*`) are found by ESLint 8.57 and newer; on ESLint 9 and 10 they are the default.

```js
// eslint.config.mjs
import cliFloor from 'eslint-plugin-cli-floor';

export default [cliFloor.configs.recommended];
```

Each preset is one flat config object: put it in the array as an element, do not spread it. Rule ids are prefixed `cli-floor/`. Add it to the config you already have; do not remove other plugins. TypeScript files need a TypeScript parser in the config (`typescript-eslint`).

## Presets

| Preset        | Rules | Errors | Warnings |
| ------------- | ----- | ------ | -------- |
| `recommended` | 3     | 3      | 0        |
| `strict`      | 4     | 4      | 0        |

### `recommended`

3 rules:

- `no-console-in-command` (error): Disallow `console.*` inside a CLI command handler; write through the output layer.
- `require-command-description` (error): Require every CLI command to declare a description.
- `require-command-example` (error): Require every runnable CLI command to declare an example, and every example to be a single line.

### `strict`

Everything in `recommended` plus 1 more:

- `no-prompt-without-flag` (error): Require every interactive prompt in a CLI command to be skippable with a flag.
